title: Kestrel and the Hollow
author: Coral Sterling
blurb: Paloma Sterling, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
